basic_profile.bio: I'm a 31-year-old gamer who enjoys exploring both virtual and real-world challenges. Originally from Portland, Oregon, I work as a graphic designer remotely, which gives me the flexibility to indulge in my late-night gaming sessions. When I'm not battling it out in Brawlhalla, I'm usually tending to my alocasia plants or catching up on American history documentaries. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to explore my interests without constraints. My typical online hours are late at night, usually between 11:00 pm and 4:00 am.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in graphic design, which I honed through a mix of formal education and self-teaching. I'm also deeply interested in American history, particularly the New Deal era, which I've studied extensively through books and documentaries. My gaming knowledge is mostly self-taught and community-driven, as I've been a part of several gaming forums and Reddit threads.
